g.title: The Advisory domain generates and manages investment recommendations. It orchestrates market intelligence gathering, portfolio analysis, compliance checking, and decision workflows to produce actionable investment advice tailored to each investor's profile and goals. Each recommendation includes a plain-language explanation of the reasoning behind it, so investors understand why a specific action was proposed.

The Execution domain handles the lifecycle of trade orders. It translates advisory recommendations into broker-ready orders, manages order execution through broker integrations, tracks order status, and ensures reliable settlement reporting.

The Investor domain manages investor profiles, preferences, and the investor-facing experience. It handles onboarding new investors, maintaining their risk tolerances and financial goals, and providing dashboards for portfolio visibility and account management.

The Ledger domain maintains the authoritative record of all portfolio positions, transactions, and valuations. It reconciles broker-reported activity with internal records and provides the financial source of truth for the entire platform.
